## Primary Clinical Services & Surgical Procedures
1. **Sinus Treatment & FESS Surgery** (https://hasnainent.com/services/sinus-treatment)
   - Conditions: Chronic sinusitis, facial pressure, nasal polyps, post-nasal drip.
   - Procedures: Functional Endoscopic Sinus Surgery (FESS), Rigid Diagnostic Nasal Endoscopy, Maxillary Sinus Lavage.
2. **Nose & Nasal Disorders / Septoplasty** (https://hasnainent.com/services/nose-disorders)
   - Conditions: Deviated Nasal Septum (DNS), enlarged turbinates, chronic nasal obstruction, epistaxis (nosebleeds).
   - Procedures: Precision Septoplasty, Coblation/Radiofrequency Turbinoplasty, Microdebrider Polypectomy.
3. **Ear Problems Treatment & Otology** (https://hasnainent.com/services/ear-treatment)
   - Conditions: Otitis media, ear discharge, perforated eardrum, swimmer's ear, severe earache.
   - Procedures: Microscopic Ear Cleaning (toilet), Digital Otoscopy, Tympanoplasty, Grommet Insertion.
4. **Throat Problems & Tonsillitis** (https://hasnainent.com/services/throat-problems)
   - Conditions: Recurrent tonsillitis, chronic pharyngitis, vocal cord hoarseness, acid reflux throat irritation (LPR).
   - Procedures: Coblation Tonsillectomy, Adenoidectomy, Flexible Fiberoptic Video Laryngoscopy.
5. **Hearing & Balance Problems / Vertigo** (https://hasnainent.com/services/hearing-balance)
   - Conditions: Sudden/progressive hearing loss, BPPV (spinning dizziness), tinnitus, inner ear labyrinthitis.
   - Procedures: Dix-Hallpike Maneuver, Bedside Epley Canalith Repositioning, Audiometric & Tympanometric review.
6. **Allergy Treatment & Allergic Rhinitis** (https://hasnainent.com/services/allergy-treatment)
   - Conditions: Morning sneezing attacks, dust/pollen allergies, itchy palate, chronic congestion in Lahore.
   - Procedures: Allergen profile evaluation, non-sedating pharmaceutical therapies, buffered pH nasal lavage protocols.
7. **Snoring & Sleep Apnea (OSA)** (https://hasnainent.com/services/snoring-sleep)
   - Conditions: Loud nighttime snoring, obstructive sleep apnea, morning dry mouth, daytime drowsiness.
   - Procedures: Upper airway endoscopy, palatal stiffening, septal airway widening, CPAP guidance.
